# USAGov

> > The official U.S. government portal connecting citizens to federal benefits, services, agencies, and civic resources through a unified discovery platform.

USAGov serves as the central hub for accessing federal programs and information, featuring live phone support, benefits discovery tools, and comprehensive guidance on government services. The site covers critical areas including Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, Federal Student Aid, housing assistance, and veteran benefits.

## Key Topics

- Social Security
- Medicare
- Medicaid
- Federal Student Aid
- Benefits finder
- Government services
- Financial aid
- Health insurance
- Housing assistance
- IRS
- Veteran benefits
- Immigration
- Unemployment benefits
- Live phone support
- Civic resources

## Core Government Benefits

- [Government benefits](https://www.usa.gov/benefits): Find programs for food, housing, medical, Social Security, and living expenses
- [Health](https://www.usa.gov/health): Medicare, Medicaid, health insurance, mental health, and substance abuse support
- [Education](https://www.usa.gov/education): Federal Student Aid, FAFSA, Head Start, special education, and child care
- [Housing help](https://www.usa.gov/housing-help): HUD assistance, Section 8, rental programs, home repair, and eviction help
- [Disability services](https://www.usa.gov/disability-services): Disability benefits (SSDI, SSI), employment, caregiver pay, and ADA rights
- [Jobs, labor laws, and unemployment](https://www.usa.gov/jobs-labor-laws-unemployment): Job search, unemployment benefits, labor laws, and retirement planning

## Financial Services & Resources

- [Taxes](https://www.usa.gov/taxes): Federal income tax filing, refunds, forms, credits, and IRS assistance
- [Money and credit](https://www.usa.gov/money): Unclaimed money, credit reports, government grants, loans, taxes, and savings
- [Small business](https://www.usa.gov/small-business): Start, fund, manage businesses; import/export licenses and resources

## Special Populations & Services

- [Military and veterans](https://www.usa.gov/military-and-veterans): Military enlistment, veteran benefits, Selective Service, and military records
- [Immigration and U.S. citizenship](https://www.usa.gov/immigration-and-citizenship): Green Cards, visas, citizenship, naturalization, DACA, and deportation info
- [Disasters and emergencies](https://www.usa.gov/disasters-and-emergencies): Disaster financial assistance, shelter, and recovery aid resources

## Legal & Civic Information

- [Laws and legal issues](https://www.usa.gov/laws-and-legal-issues): Vital documents, legal aid, family law, crime support, and court information
- [The U.S. and its government](https://www.usa.gov/about-the-us): Overview of U.S. government structure, branches, and how to contact officials
- [Travel](https://www.usa.gov/travel): Passport applications, travel documents, REAL ID, visas, and travel tips

## Customer Support & Protection

- [Call USAGov](https://www.usa.gov/phone): Live agent phone support for federal benefits and government services inquiries
- [Scams and fraud](https://www.usa.gov/scams-and-fraud): Identity theft, Social Security scams, fraud prevention, and reporting guidance
- [Complaints](https://www.usa.gov/complaints): File complaints about agencies, telemarketers, travel, housing, and banking

## Portal & Navigation

- [Making government services easier to find | USAGov](https://www.usa.gov): Central portal for discovering federal benefits, services, agencies, and civic resources

## Optional

- [Innovation](https://www.usa.gov/innovation): Citizen science, challenges, competitions, and volunteer participation programs
